targets.query: from(bucket: "fluxhaus") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gt3_telemetry" and r._field == "speed")
from(bucket: "fluxhaus") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gt3_telemetry" and r._field == "battery")
from(bucket: "fluxhaus") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gt3_telemetry" and (r._field == "bms1_temp" or r._field == "bms2_temp" or r._field == "body_temp"))
from(bucket: "fluxhaus") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gt3_health" and r._field == "heart_rate")
